description: Extract full metadata for a video/audio URL (title, description, duration, uploader, formats, thumbnails, view counts) without downloading the media. Works on YouTube, TikTok, X, and 1000+ sites — no yt-dlp to run yourself. Async: poll check_metadata with the returned jobId. For just title/duration/thumbnail, prefer the faster get_basic_metadata.
name: get_metadata
